feature: message idempotency payload digest and read projection
method: HTTP sends with clientMessageId, isolated data dirs, 2000 messages of ~6 KB Chinese text; state/page timings are client-visible averages over 15-20 requests; storage is chat.sqlite size after clean shutdown

storage.note: before stored the full request JSON in clientPayload in addition to text; after stores sha256:<hex>

read.dataset: 200 latest messages, each ~6 KB text and a ~6 KB payload on the legacy rows
read.note: all responses already stripped clientPayload; selecting it only cost SQLite/JS copying. Byte counts are unchanged because text dominates.

idempotency.legacyJsonRetry: same message id and the row was rewritten to a digest

note: The digest is computed only when clientMessageId is present. Legacy JSON payloads are compared by exact string first, then by re-serialized JSON, so old rows keep idempotent retry semantics and shrink on their next successful retry.

autoforge.targetedTests: 15/15 passed (29.8 s, includes 5 sentinel tests and the legacy payload test)
autoforge.scope: adapter-reported build/test only; no runtime or deployment claim
limitations: operator-owned adapters run outside a sandbox
test_pass covers the targeted acceptance subset; the full node --test suite was run separately
autoforge.note: cumulative candidate contains the 2026-11-14 visibility, worker budget/paging, wake fan-out, language-cache and payload-digest changes
